heading: Your profile
unconfirmedBody: A few facts about you let the app work out the energy your body uses at rest. Nothing here is shared anywhere.
birthDateWhy: Stored as a date, so your age stays right without you updating it.
sexWhy: Used to work out the energy your body uses at rest — the formula differs.
activityWhy: How much you move across the whole day — work, getting around, time on your feet — not how often you train. This is what turns the resting figure into a daily total, and it is the least certain part of it.

activityDescription.sedentary: Desk work and sitting for most of the day, with little walking.
activityDescription.active: On your feet for a good part of the day, or getting around on foot.
activityDescription.vigorous: Physically demanding work, or long hours of movement most days.

targetOptional: Optional. Nothing is predicted from it — you will see the distance, never a date.

baseline.heading: Energy baseline
baseline.restingWhat: Roughly the energy your body uses at rest.
baseline.maintenanceUnknown: What you burn in a day depends on how active you are:
baseline.leanMassValue: From lean mass instead: {{kcal}} kcal a day.
baseline.provenance: Mifflin–St Jeor (1990) for the resting figure, Cunningham (1991) from lean mass, and FAO/WHO/UNU (2001) activity bands. The activity band is a range because the published figure is a range — it is the least certain part of this.
baseline.noFigure: No baseline yet — a few facts are still missing, and a figure built on guesses would be worse than none.

pal.sedentary: Assuming mostly sitting, with light activity.
pal.active: Assuming an active day, most days.

direction.increasing: Your measurements have been going up.
direction.decreasing: Your measurements have been going down.
